messages:
Alex: Hey folks — I'm OOO next Wed (22nd). Can someone facilitate ARB that week? Quick agenda: 1) KV-cache RFC (final pass), 2) canary rollout policy for Dedicated, 3) platform linter rule for SDK. Need a facilitator + who'll do pre-read notes. Prefer someone to run the canary discussion first. Thanks :pray:

Maria: I can take the slot. Quick Q — how long are we planning? 45 min or 60?

Sam: 45 should be fine. If KV RFC needs more we can spin out a follow-up.

Vijay: heads-up — KV RFC has a last-minute perf benchmark. Can we push that item to the end? I want to present results.

Alex: sounds good — bump KV to #3. Keep canary first. I'll drop the RFC pre-read link here before EOD.

Triage Bot: Reminder: please attach RFC pre-reads to the meeting thread or add to calendar invite. Template: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/template

Maria: cool. I'll own the invite + facilitator notes. Any volunteers to take quick notes?

Sam: I'll take notes and add action items to the meeting doc.

Maria: awesome, assigning roles. I'll also ping infra to bring the canary rollout matrix. @Vijay can you add the perf table to the RFC doc? :thumbsup:

Vijay: will do, adding perf table and short summary. ETA tomorrow noon.

Alex: thanks all. Agenda draft (45m): ```- 0-20m: Canary rollout policy (infra + product concerns)
- 20-30m: platform linter rule proposal (compatibility / rollout)
- 30-45m: KV-cache RFC perf summary + decision/next-steps```

Maria: perfect. I'll send invite for Wed 10:00am PT and attach doc. anyone can't make ping here, we can swap hosts.

Sam: 10am PT works for me.

Vijay: good for me too. :calendar:

Alex: thanks y'all — leaving follow-ups to Maria/Sam. Have a good weekend :sunny:
